newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields edge higher on EMU worries.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields edge higher on EMU worries.

text.p: Debt yields ended higher and the crown softened on Monday on renewed worries about Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU) after a surprise win by the left in the first round of France's parliamentary elections.

Trade was very thin since U.S. and British markets were closed. Market focus was on second round of the French elections and on the Swedish government's EMU stance, due to be presented before the end of May. * Six month T-bill rate was three basis points up at 4.26 pct * Ten year bond yield rises seven basis points to 7.10 pct * Crown softens to 4.5115 versus the mark versus 4.4910 Friday
